limitations: Zero personalization: identical recommendations provided to all users
Extreme popularity bias: top decile items occupy 100% of catalog recommendations
Disregards user historical preferences and implicit feedback
Popularity.remediation: Transition to personalized collaborative filtering or hybrid model.

limitations: Overspecialization: recommendations restricted to genres user has previously consumed
Metadata dependency: relies on static genre tags; cannot capture subtle stylistic preference
Low coverage of niche items without detailed metadata tags
Content.remediation: Incorporate dense text embeddings (e.g., plot summaries) and collaborative signal.

limitations: Cold-start user vulnerability: zero recommendations for unobserved new users
Memory scalability: O(N_users^2) cosine similarity computation during real-time inference
Sparsity sensitivity: performance drops significantly when user interaction matrix sparsity > 98%
User-Based CF.remediation: Precompute user neighbor indices offline or apply matrix factorization (ALS/SVD).

limitations: Cold-start item vulnerability: inability to recommend items with <= 5 ratings
Static similarity graph: requires complete retrain to recognize newly published movies
Limited serendipity: tends to recommend highly similar items to recent views
Item-Based CF.remediation: Hybridize with content features for new items (cold-start fallback).

limitations: Hyperparameter sensitivity: linear combination parameter alpha=0.5 requires offline tuning
Computational latency: requires dual-path scoring (Content + Item-CF) per request
Inherits cold-start degradation when both constituent sub-models lack signal
Hybrid.remediation: Implement adaptive alpha per user activity level (e.g. higher content weight for sparse users).

data_limitations.temporal_coverage: Static snapshot; lacks streaming real-time interaction logs
data_limitations.demographic_data: Absent (no age, gender, or location attributes available)

impact_assessment.description: High sparsity and positive skew restrict offline generalization to multi-million user production setups.

evaluation_limitations.offline_vs_online: Offline top-K precision/recall measures historical replay hit-rate, not true user click/watch conversion.
evaluation_limitations.top_k_truncation: Evaluation fixed at top 5, 10, 20 items; ignores long-tail discovery behavior.
evaluation_limitations.static_split: Random timestamp split does not simulate streaming production drift perfectly.

impact_assessment.description: Offline offline metrics serve as upper-bound proxies; online A/B testing is required for validation.

deployment_limitations.inference_latency: User-Based CF single-request latency scales linearly with active user table size.
deployment_limitations.memory_footprint: In-memory item-item similarity matrix requires ~50MB RAM; full MovieLens 32M would require >16GB.
deployment_limitations.cold_start_fallback: Requires pre-warmed Popularity/Content cache in Streamlit session state.

impact_assessment.description: Real-time deployment requires offline pre-computation and redis/vector search caching.

real_world_applicability.explicit_vs_implicit: Engine trained on explicit ratings; real-world apps predominantly rely on implicit (clicks/watches).
real_world_applicability.feedback_loops: Recsys predictions alter user exposure, creating self-fulfilling popularity feedback loops.
real_world_applicability.business_constraints: Does not enforce catalog business rules (licensing restrictions, age ratings, sponsored content).

scalability_considerations.horizontal_scaling: Models currently run single-threaded in Python memory space.
scalability_considerations.catalog_growth: Item-CF matrix re-fitting time scales quadratic with catalog size O(|I|^2).
scalability_considerations.recommended_architecture: Migrate to PySpark / Annoy / FAISS for > 1M catalog items.

known_failure_modes.trigger: User ID absent from training set
known_failure_modes.remediation: Automatic fallback to Popularity / Onboarding cold-start recommendations.

known_failure_modes.trigger: Movie ID absent from training set
known_failure_modes.remediation: Content-based fallbacks using genre TF-IDF tags.

known_failure_modes.trigger: User has < 2 ratings in training set
known_failure_modes.remediation: Route to Hybrid model with content weighting alpha=0.8.
